carnation
音标：英 /kɑː'neɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /kɑr'neʃən/

n. 狠毒
例句：Scorn, bitterness, unprovoked malignity, gratuitous desire of ill, ridicule of whatever was good and holy, all awoke, to tempt, even while they frightened him.
